big: Nifty Total Market is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

h: What is the Nifty Total Market?
lines: What does the Nifty Total Market track?
The Nifty Total Market Index will track the performance of 750 stocks covering large, mid, small and microcap segments. It holds 755 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.

intro: NSE factsheet, 30 Sep 2026, as per the lesson. Past returns do not predict the future.
note: P/E is price relative to earnings. A higher P/E means investors pay more for each rupee of earnings.

q: The Nifty Total Market P/E is 21.96 and the Nifty 50 P/E is 19.36. How do they compare?
why: 21.96 is above 19.36, so this reverses the facts.
